capabilities: Browse column articles by category in a sidebar
Save articles to the vault with one click
Fetch article content from a GitHub repository
extras: Article content is licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (plugin source MIT); the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author distributes their personal writing column directly to readers as an Obsidian plugin.
problem: There is no built-in way to subscribe to and read an author's article column inside Obsidian; installing the plugin acts as the subscription.
summary: Column reader that delivers an author's personal writing column as a plugin, with a sidebar for browsing and saving articles to the vault.
